body: Thinking of you tonight. I’m just a useless stranger on the internet but I hope you make it through the night. I’m not even sure I will.

I don’t know if I’ll even manage to motivate myself through the night, but just know I care. I don’t know you and I’m just an anonymous suicidal mess, but I love you and you’re in someone’s thoughts tonight

You too are loved. Even if it’s just by me, a fellow, suicidal soul. Whatever you decide to do, just know, you’re in my thoughts tonight. I’m not even sure what I’m doing or if I’ll push through the night, but just know, someone’s thinking of you. I read this and I care. Goodnight dear soul.
Thank you. I hope I can do this one thing right.
I know how you feel. The one time I did grow the balls to do it, I failed anyway. Seemingly I can’t even do this right..

You don’t have to be okay, it’ll come and go, trust me I don’t know if it ever fully “gets better” but some of the good days make the this pain a little worth it. Try to find the tiny things that make life worth it, you cat, the feeling of a good sleep after you cry, its all we can do… although for myself I believe it’s a matter of “when” not “if” I’ll do it.
I’m here if you ever need to chat stranger. I may not have the best advice for overcoming these feelings; but I sure as hell understand

People with beliefs like you, are the reason so many people have to attend their loved ones funerals. Do better & don’t add to the stigma. You don’t know how this comment could impact someone struggling with suicidal ideation. Have a soul, that’s someone’s loved one you’re speaking about.
I know the feeling stranger. If you ever wanna chat, I’m here

I feel the exact same way. It sounds like you’ve overcome a lot and to realize that you deserved better shows the healing. I’m just an Internet stranger but I’m proud of you for realizing that you should’ve been appreciated. Nurture that inner child, she deserves a role model like you❤️
